Tags:
**Mod Manager **- External aplication for managing mods
**Library **- Used by other mods
**Utility **- Safe to remove midgame simply by disabling the mod
**Megamod** - If you have to ask, your mod isn't a megamod
**Faction **- Adds faction(s) to the campaign
**Ship Pack **- Adds ship(s) to the game, not attached to a faction
**Weapon/Fighter Pack** - Adds weapon(s) to the game, not attached to a faction
**Modular Hullmods **- Adds modular hullmods to the game, not attached to a faction
**Quests and Bars** - Adds narrative content, or anything you'd find at your local space bar (not that one)
**Colonies **- Adds content for colonies
**Exploration **- Adds exploration content
**Misc. Campaign Mods** - Campaign content that doesn't fit into the above categories
**Officers **- Adds or affects officer mechanics
**Skill Change/Rework** - Adds or affects skill mechanics
**Quality of Life** - Improves life quality
**Audio/Visual **- Makes your game look ✨ pretty ✨ and sound 🫦
**Portrait / Flag Pack **- For all your degenerate aesthetic needs. Try to make sure a child can draw those flags
**Other/Miscellaneous** - Where everything else goes
**Total Conversion** - If you have to ask, your mod is probably a total conversion
